title: dryopteris pubescens var. muscosa
intro: Dryopteris pubescens var. muscosa, commonly known as the hairy fern, is a variety of the Dryopteris pubescens plant, a type of evergreen fern that is native to North America. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory issues. The hairy fern is said to have therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and expectorant properties, which can help to soothe coughs and relieve congestion. The bioactive constituents of the hairy fern include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoid saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
